title: Tier 3 Coder Receipt
description: Structured receipt returned by every Tier 3 coding pass (codex exec --output-schema). No diffs, file contents, or raw logs are allowed in any field. orchestrate.sh appends commit_sha and pr_url to the ledger after it commits and opens the PR.

status.description: DONE: just check passed in the worktree. CONTRACT_DEFECT: a frozen contract or acceptance test is syntactically invalid or impossible (exit on strike 1). ESCALATE_STRIKE_3: three verification failures.

attempt.description: Verification attempt on which the pass stopped.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths written by this pass. Must be a subset of OWNED_FILES.

command.description: The command that produced the summary, normally `just check`.

summary_line.description: The single final summary line from the test runner. Never a log.

defect_location.description: file:line of the defect inside a frozen contract or acceptance test. Required (non-null) when status is CONTRACT_DEFECT, null otherwise.

root_cause.description: At most 3 sentences. Required (non-null) when status is ESCALATE_STRIKE_3 or CONTRACT_DEFECT, null when DONE.

triage_hypothesis.description: The 10-failure-triage hypothesis stated before attempt 3. Null if the pass never reached strike 2.

deps_added.description: Packages added. Every entry must be in the task's APPROVED_DEPS.
